en: Black-and-white postcard showing a passenger steamship named "NORRTELJE" docking at a small pier. Many people are boarding or disembarking along the gangway. The scene is set on a wooded lakeshore or coastal area with houses visible among trees across the water and a house and rustic fences in the foreground. Swedish text is printed along the bottom margin, including a caption about the ship and publisher details.
